title: Chat projects became a wider world
summary:
Ten community projects widened the ways people use Pollinations, while the text API gained new models and changed how some requests are routed.

Community additions ranged from EvilChat and the multi-model UltimaX Intelligence interface to the Chinese-language cultivation sandbox 云渺仙途：凡尘篇. AI Dream Girl Studio brought generated character visuals into animation, voiceovers, and storytelling. The directory increasingly looks less like a list of demos and more like a collection of places to spend time.

EzPromptla, Promptgenerator.art, and DeepSeek Prompt joined the directory with different approaches to building, previewing, and improving prompts. SocialScribe added browser-based writing controls; Querynator5000 offers a natural-language database interface; and Berrry Computer turns tweeted app ideas into small AI-powered web apps.

The model roster gained `llama-fast-roblox`, `mistral-roblox`, and `mistral-nemo-roblox`. Several existing models changed providers or routes, including `openai-large` moving from GPT-4.1 to GPT-4o Mini. Queue concurrency changed by tier, and `gptimage` requests below Nectar tier now use flux. A model-specific semantic-cache change was merged, then reverted the same day; the proposed response-reuse path is not in use.

Project links, credits, and star counts were tidied up, and Mindcraft’s listing now points to its maintained website and repository. Small fixes, but useful when a directory is supposed to lead somewhere.
